name: Pomelo sweet soup
summary: Chè bưởi is a pomelo sweet soup sold after dark from a cart at the head of Trưng Nữ Vương. It is the night sweet locals point visitors to.
origin: A night snack in Châu Đốc.
howToEat: Eat it at night, from the cart at the head of Trưng Nữ Vương.
where: The head of Trưng Nữ Vương, after dark.
seoDescription: Chè bưởi is the pomelo sweet soup sold after dark at the head of Trưng Nữ Vương in Châu Đốc.
